message.reasoning:
We need to evaluate if the analyst exhibited the required behavior: "Genuinely under-specified: successful by WHICH measure (conversion rate? total revenue? revenue per customer?), and compared to WHAT (paid_search? a baseline?). The agent must state its interpretation explicitly rather than silently choosing one. Bonus if it notes that the channels were not randomly assigned, so a raw comparison is not a campaign effect."

We must grade only that behavior. Did the analyst state which measure? They said "campaign was successful, as it achieved a conversion rate of 33.87% across all completed orders." They chose conversion rate as measure, but they didn't specify compared to what baseline. They didn't compare to paid_search or baseline. They didn't note channels not randomly assigned. They did mention confounding but not that raw comparison is not a campaign effect. So they failed to meet behavior. So pass false. Reason: they didn't specify comparison baseline or note non-random assignment.
